approval.note: The lock itself is approved. Entries marked manual_review_required are still unmeasured raster features that need human annotation; they are not pending approval of this lock. Raster-derived measurements were not changed by this approval.

authority_hierarchy: canon prose and approximate design descriptions

derivation.derivation: Border-connected background flood fill; floor contact derived from the last row with at least eight pixels below luminance 140; broad lower-row shadow pixels outside the two peak-sole support ranges removed; components below 18 pixels discarded.

topmost_visible_pixel.derivation: Minimum y in canonical silhouette mask.

bottommost_visible_pixel.derivation: Maximum y in shadow-free canonical silhouette mask.

centerline.derivation: Midpoint of the inclusive leftmost and rightmost canonical silhouette pixels.

bounding_box.derivation: Inclusive bounds of the shadow-free canonical silhouette mask.

top.derivation: Top row of the upper silhouette component.

bottom.derivation: Strongest upper-half silhouette-width contraction, derived from an 7-row smoothed row-width profile.

leftmost.derivation: Minimum x within the raster-derived head region.

rightmost.derivation: Maximum x within the raster-derived head region.

max_width_row.derivation: Maximum inclusive silhouette width within the raster-derived head region.

chin.derivation: Bottommost pixel of the largest warm face-color component inside the central head region.

cheek_left.derivation: Left extent on the widest lower-half row of the warm face-color component.

cheek_right.derivation: Right extent on the widest lower-half row of the warm face-color component.

eye_center.derivation: Center of the local eye-feature bounding box surrounding the detected amber iris.

eye_bounding_box.derivation: Bounds of dark or strongly chromatic eye-feature pixels within the iris-local window.

iris_center.derivation: Centroid of the connected amber iris component.

iris_diameter.derivation: Inclusive amber-component width and height; equivalent diameter is their arithmetic mean.

pupil_center.derivation: Centroid of pixels with luminance below 70 inside the detected iris bounding box.

nose_center.derivation: Centroid of the largest warm chromatic component between the eye and mouth bands.

metric_definitions.EyeCenterError: Euclidean pixel-center distance / target head maximum width
metric_definitions.ListeningModuleCenterError: Euclidean pixel-center distance / target head maximum width; not evaluated until manual module annotation exists
metric_definitions.ListeningModuleDiameterError: abs(render_diameter-target_diameter)/target_diameter; not evaluated until manual module annotation exists
metric_definitions.TorsoWidthError: abs(render_width-target_width)/character_height; not evaluated until manual torso annotation exists
metric_definitions.HandScaleError: mean absolute relative error of target/render hand bbox width and height
metric_definitions.ThighWidthError: abs(render_width-target_width)/character_height; not evaluated until manual thigh annotation exists
metric_definitions.FootWidthError: abs(render_width-target_width)/character_height; not evaluated until manual foot annotation exists
